notes.title: Version 1.1.0 - Ari Update
notes.content:
A wild new character appears. She is super effective. 

Imagine this Anon, you get lost on a train. But it's not all bad - you meet Ari, An adventurous cute neko girl. No spoilers here, just run the game and see what happens next.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44749119/88db87779e5c12539371963f048525baf3ce452b.jpg

Another thing - now you can actually see where an in-game collectible card comes from. Something we added for conveniance.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44749119/31f8820c738a3a0b43612019f211cd104bcc599b.png

Can you get all the 69 in-game collectible cards?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44749119/d46f7271dc3e76229cc8ded3df86758aee874781.png

• Improved translations in all languages

• Other minor bugfixes

New scene{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44749119/c0db5791665fe9bd659b41d7b09418c1ac0c9856.jpg

notes.title: version 1.0.8
notes.content:
More content is on its way to you. In the meantime we are massaging the game code, getting rid of some pesky bugs, fixing typos. We are aware of some translation problems, we have deployed special code-nekos to fix them. The entire leveling thing does not feel very rewarding atm so we are aiming to do some changes in the RPG department of Anon's Neko Waifus as well. But dear Anons, here is the stuff we managed to do so far:

• Fixed characters playing wrong animation

• Fixed missing voice acting

• Fixed wrong dialogue direction descriptions in some parts of dialogues

• Fixed short Asian dialogue directions overlapping dialogue text

• Fixed language window, always asking for language at the start of the game

• Balanced audio levels across all dialogues, fixed dialogue lines that were too silent

• Expanded and changed some Sara dialogues

• Second garden party dialogue with Tami is a bit longer now

• Niko dialogue by the seaside is a bit longer now

• Fixed 2 broken achievements

• Added 10 new achievements

still some bugs left, mainly the "." dots appearing in different parts of text where they should not

notes.title: Holiday Update
notes.content:
Hey Anon. We've been trying to reach you about the new update. You have 2 new Xmas scenes with Tami and Sara. They are both very excited about that.
Also the translation is bit better now. Happy holidays and all the best
